case_name: Sri Shivalingaiah vs Smt K Bhuwaneshwari

parties.respondent_defendant: SMT. K. BHUWANESHWARI (wife), SMT. SAVITHA, SMT. RAJESHWARI, SRI HARISH

facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who got married in 1993. The wife filed a private complaint against the husband and others alleging offences punishable under Sections 420, 494 and 506 of IPC. The trial court acquitted all accused, but the Sessions Court convicted the husband for the same offences.
